notes: Current 2025 Chablis Premier Cru label rule. Every one of the 40 listed climats may be claimed by its own name. In addition, the principal climat heading each of the 17 legal groups may be used for wine physically originating in any climat within that same group. These are explicit cover-name permissions, not aliases or geographic identity mergers.

chablis_masaa_2025.scope: Official 40-name Premier Cru climat list. The principal climat at the head of each group may, by usage, designate wines from all climats within that group.

rules.notes: Exact physical climat claims are legal. A different requested name is legal only when it is the principal cover name of the physical site's expressly defined 2025 group. Cross-group substitutions remain fail-closed.
